review.result: Positive callback array is XCTUnwrap-required; nil fails. kind/sequence/deltaUp assertions are retained. Removed success DTO completedEffects access is replaced by same shared LoginManager revision and stored credentials after awaited service completion.

Positive receipt events are XCTUnwrap-required before map/last/first. Actual typed update and reuse forms remain unchanged, including stable physical IDs, new raw versus retained type/action/labels, visible edit, working Map and UI_BINDING_ERROR. Generic/key-path diagnostics following the malformed event chain are inference consequences; no production layout/model change is introduced.

Blank prelude still requires executed=false. Optional nil and present empty arrays both represent zero events under the existing wire; a nonempty array fails. Same owner credential value and revision are compared before/after skip.

Fixture and product host use LoginManager.shared and a unique synthetic source. Accepted runtime credential changes call advanceRuntimeLoginInfoRevision before returning, legacy accepted changed store advances the same revision, and revisions are monotonic. Reads are in Task.detached and awaited outside Main; seeded valid Keychain Map means the checked interval is not a legacy-migration probe.

All actual errors are in the two inherited methods: optional array .map selected Optional.map and lost the element type, unwrapped first/last/isEmpty, nonexistent action success completedEffects, plus downstream key-path/Equatable inference. Five minimal edits reverse to every baseline byte; actual7576 two method bodies are byte-identical to current a03 baseline.

proofBoundary: Unchanged owner revision plus actual credential Map after an awaited operation checks that no accepted logical credential mutation completed in this interval, including a change-and-restore which would still advance revision.

This replacement does not assert that a MayCommit was never attempted, rejected, or a same-value no-op owner call never occurred. The success DTO exposes no effects; no fictional absence-of-MayCommit proof is claimed.
Dictionary equality here checks the seeded ASCII credential Map; it is not an exact raw-byte/no-Keychain-I/O measurement. No new telemetry/API is added merely to repair fixture compilation.

An unchanged shared revision also covers accepted header changes and can be stronger than credential equality; callback/blank skip intentionally perform neither. The first explicit header action precedes the callback baseline revision.
This file omits later independently reviewed Header/V2 browser additions. Root must perform method-level union, preserving all newer methods/fixtures rather than replacing the whole current file.
